result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, restaurant cards, and bottom navigation are all aligned and legible. The partially visible third card in 'Fastest near you' is expected horizontal scrolling behavior and was not counted as a defect. No critical or major visual problems were found.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the bell icon is very small and sits partially over the bell outline, making it easy to miss at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Increase the badge contrast (e.g., darker dot with a thin white outline) so it stands out more clearly against the white bell button background.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' card title is truncated mid-word with no visible ellipsis, which could read as a typo rather than clipping.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the collapsed card title is clearly clipped (or add a subtle right-edge fade) so users understand more text exists and can scroll to see it.
